purpose: Make every sentence, question, observation, action description, response and correction enter Sourceborn as a traceable local Sequence, decompose it to bounded machine objects, activate existing rubrics/parameters, route bounded Engines and Node Brains, contribute to pattern memory, and expose interpretations/rubric activations for user review before any learned pattern is promoted.
pattern_rule: Every local micro-Sequence produces a PATTERN_CONTRIBUTION. It may activate, support, contradict or weaken an existing pattern. A new reusable Pattern Candidate is created only when evidence or an explicit user instruction justifies candidate formation.

resolution_ladder.name: CLAUSE_AND_PHRASE
resolution_ladder.stores: bounded clauses, phrases, negation, modality, qualifiers

resolution_ladder.name: ENTITY_AND_REFERENCE
resolution_ladder.stores: entities, pronouns, ownership, role, reference resolution status

resolution_ladder.name: ACTION_EVENT
resolution_ladder.stores: actions, events, requests, omissions, transfers, commitments

resolution_ladder.name: EPISTEMIC_VIEW
resolution_ladder.stores: known, believed, inferred, unknown, hidden, confidence, source

resolution_ladder.name: HUMAN_CANDIDATES
resolution_ladder.stores: emotion, feeling, motive, intent, expectation and value candidates; candidates are not facts

resolution_ladder.name: DIFFERENCE_EXPECTATION
resolution_ladder.stores: expected vs observed, promise vs result, repeated difference, boundary/constraint difference

resolution_ladder.name: ENGINE_NODE_ROUTE
resolution_ladder.stores: bounded Engine and ASI Node requests with input/output contracts

resolution_ladder.name: PATTERN_CONTRIBUTION
resolution_ladder.stores: support/contradict/weaken/new-candidate contribution against prior closed Sequences

resolution_ladder.name: USER_REVIEW_WRITEBACK
resolution_ladder.stores: edits, interpretation, feeling, boundary, approval scope and versioned write-back Sequence

execution_stages.name: HUMAN_AFFECT_INTENT_HYPOTHESES
execution_stages.guard: Intent/emotion labels remain candidate/inferred unless directly evidenced or user-attributed.

execution_stages.name: VERSIONED_LEARNING_WRITEBACK
execution_stages.guard: Never mutate a closed prior Sequence. Create a new write-back Sequence referencing prior evidence and the review decision.

small_brain_rule.principle: Each Node Brain stores and evaluates only its bounded local contract; the whole sentence is assembled through typed packets rather than copied into every node.
forbidden: silent promotion of inference to fact

pyramid_addressing_rule: Route from coarse Segment/Container meaning toward Parameter/Sub-Parameter/Element resolution only as required by the declared end, ambiguity, contradiction, threshold or user drill-down. Do not activate all parameters by default.
user_edit_rule: The UI/runtime must expose the activated rubric path and allow the authorized user to edit interpretation, feeling/emotion attribution, meaning, boundary/rule, pattern name, applicability and approval scope. The original machine proposal remains immutable as provenance; the edit creates a versioned review/write-back object.
closure_rule: Sentence analysis may close once its local representation/review contract is terminal. Open pattern review or learning write-back must remain a separate required or optional Sub-Sequence according to the parent contract.
